newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK bourse details trading suspensions.
newsitem.headline: HK bourse details trading suspensions.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong on Tuesday released a "Prolonged Suspension Status Report" on shares suspended from trade for three months or more, detailing the reasons and current status.
"We are examining the possibility of issuing the report periodically, say once every two weeks, so as to raise the transparency of the companies," an exchange spokeswoman said.
